name: homelab-proxmox
description: Manage your Proxmox VE homelab from Claude through your own self-hosted MCP server: health checks, outage troubleshooting, safe VM changes and Docker inside VMs.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: HTTPS address of your self-hosted Proxmox MCP server's /mcp endpoint, e.g. https://pve-mcp.example.com/mcp. See the README to set one up.

auth_token.title: Server access token
auth_token.description: The PROXMOX_MCP_AUTH_TOKEN you set on your server. Stored securely.
